kind: in-memory ELF runner gated behind a self-build switch (emulator verified)

runtimeBehavior.defaultBuild: DshEngine reads dsh-self-build.json, deletes any stale /usr/bin/mh-exec and logs 'signed exec bypass disabled: store build'
runtimeBehavior.selfBuild: DshEngine writes mh-exec.py to /usr/bin/mh-exec as an executable file; the Host startup hook also chmods it 0755 as a fallback

verifiedOnEmulator.default: mh-exec ABSENT after installing the default HAP over a previous self-build install

selfBuildRun.command: curl busybox-static apk -> gzip -> tar -> MH_ELF_ARGV0=busybox mh-exec ./bbx/bin/busybox.static echo MH_EXEC_SWITCH_OK

distributionPolicy.storeBuilds: HARMONY_SELF_BUILD is unset/false; the loader script is not packaged and any stale copy is removed at launch
distributionPolicy.selfBuilt: opt-in with HARMONY_SELF_BUILD=1 or the GitHub workflow dispatch input self_build_bypass
distributionPolicy.notes: the in-memory runner deliberately bypasses the platform code-signing boundary and must not be used for store distribution
